items.headline: Army, Navy to meet a week earlier in '27 to avoid College Football Playoff
items.description: The annual Army-Navy game, one of the most storied rivalries in college football, will be played a week earlier beginning next season to avoid conflicts with the expanded College Football Playoff.

items.headline: Hodges and Medders score, Air Force clinches Commander-in-Chief's Trophy in 24-21 win over Army
items.description: — Kemper Hodges and Evan Medders each ran for a touchdown as Air Force defeated Army 24-21 on Saturday to secure their first Commander-in-Chief's Trophy since 2022.
